title: one shared test file makes parallel changes conflict
what: Split tests/test_relay.py (~2000 lines, ~100 classes) into files by subject (tests/test_rules.py, test_setup.py, test_check.py, ...), so changes to different areas touch different files; new tests go to the file of their area. Keep one runner command (pytest tests) unchanged.
why: 24 Oct: 3 of 5 merges either conflicted or were combined in tests/test_relay.py (no-merge-page, principles, projects-out, auto-merge). Every parallel change appends a test class at its end, so each take-master costs a gate (~9 min), a recorded finding and a checker. Repeats on every parallel change (MEDIUM by the waste principle).
failing_case: Two branches from the same master each add a test class for different areas: merging the second into master after the first conflicts in tests/test_relay.py.
pass_cases: The same two branches add their tests to different files and merge without a conflict or a combined file; pytest tests runs the same number of tests as before the split.
